reviews.text: Let me start out by saying what a nightmare it was to find an affordable and honest tree removing service after our area suffered a severe thunderstorm that threw our neighbors tree into our backyard.
reviews.author: Katelyn M.

reviews.text: Rob was very quick in responding to my request for a quote. He provided me with a date for the work and followed through on time. He evaluated the job I was requesting and even discussed potential issues with work near our fence.
reviews.author: Lesley H.

reviews.text: I had gotten four quotes from different companies. Douglas Tree Services was the lowest and best price. The highest price was $3700.00 then $2400.00 the last said they don't cut down trees. I would highly recommend them to do any kind of work.
reviews.author: Richard
